name: Enroll Contact Into Workflow
description: Add a contact to a workflow. Note: The Workflows API currently only supports contact-based workflows and is only available for Marketing Hub Enterprise accounts. [See the documentation](https://legacydocs.hubspot.com/docs/methods/workflows/add_contact)

configurable_props.name: workflow
configurable_props.label: Workflow
configurable_props.description: The ID of the workflow you wish to see metadata for.

configurable_props.name: contactEmail
configurable_props.label: Contact Email
configurable_props.description: The email of the contact to be added to the list. Note - this needs to be a contact that already exists within HubSpot. You may need to add a Create or Update Contact step before this one. Then, use the email created in that step in this field.
